transcript: Speaker A: English mein haarne ke ye paanch lakshan kabhi mat karna. Pehla, bina tyaari ke interview mat do. Bade bade words yaad karne se nahi hota. Simple aur clear English bolo jo HR samjhe. Utilize ki jagah use bolo. Show off mat karo, confidence dikhao. Teesra, "Tell me about yourself" ka answer copy karna band karo. Wahi das line das lakh logon ne rate hain. Sabse same answer, sabse same reject. Ye copy karne wala dusra andha. Chautha, interview se do minute pehle tyaari mat karo. Match se do minute pehle team banaoge toh tukka lagega. Jo crack karte hain, wo do hafte pehle "Tell me about yourself", "Why this company", "Strengths, weaknesses" sab practice karte hain. Paanchwa, English sirf samajhna band karo, bolna shuru karo. Chaar ghante sirf reels dekhte ho, zero minute English bolte ho. Wahi 15 minute mein AI coach se practice karo toh interview mein fluent jawab de sakte ho.
